# Issue templates

## Files

- [bug_report.yml](bug_report.yml): the bug form; asks for what happened, the command, the environment and an example texture.
- [feature_request.yml](feature_request.yml): the feature form; asks for the goal and the wanted change.
- [config.yml](config.yml): turns off blank issues and links the private vulnerability report page.
  Related: [../../SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).
